worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.summary: The user makes several heavy swings along one wide arc, hitting every foe in the fan; afterwards it is left dazed for the longest exhaustion window, unable to act or move.
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.descript: The user swings %2$s times along one arc, each sweep dealing about %1$s contact damage to every enemy in the fan.
Each sweep reaches %1$s blocks, opens %2$s degrees and is spaced %3$s apart.
Afterwards the user is dazed for %1$s: unable to start new moves or ordinary attacks, and unable to move.
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.use.0: A rapid flurry of heavy close swings
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.use.1: Sweep several foes packed in front at once
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.use.2: Trade the longest exhaustion for the highest burst
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.preferen: How many heavy swings along the arc. More swings deal more total damage but daze longer and take longer; fewer swings recover sooner at lower risk.
Below this health fraction the user stops starting Meteor Assaults (unless the target is nearly down). Higher avoids being dazed and punished.
On: when two or more enemies are packed in front, sweep them for multiple hits. Off: look only at the single target and swing whenever close.
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.timing: Quick wind-up, medium recovery; sweeps are evenly spaced and the daze settles after the last one.
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.growth.0: From level 40 each swing gains another step with level.
